commit_message: Render ADR0127 Camera2D in Game View
pr_title: GameEngine: complete ADR0127 Native 2D first release
pr_body: Continues ADR0127 first-release completion. Extends Game View camera selection across Camera3D and Camera2D, renders Camera2D with its orthographic projection, preserves deterministic runtime tie-breaking, and leaves the ADR0103 explicit Editor Scene View Camera3D path unchanged.
